provenance.construction: Coset lifted product (CLP) code, Definition III.1 of arXiv:2610.12782, 1x1 over 2x2 layout, check weight 6. G = SmallGroup(1200,642) (GAP SmallGroups id), H = <f6*f7> = C5 given by generators in the polycyclic generating sequence f1,f2,... of G, m = [G:H] = 240, n = 4m = 960. Protograph a over F_2[G] acts by the left coset action on G/H, protograph B over F_2[N_G(H)] by the right coset action. a = 1 + f3*f4*f5*f6^4*f7^3 + f2*f3*f4*f5^2*f6^2;  B = [[1, 1 + f1*f2*f3*f4*f5*f7], [1 + f1*f2*f3*f4, f1*f2*f3*f4*f5*f7^4]]. Rebuild with gap/rebuild.g in https://github.com/rajendrarajpurohit/CLP_QLDPC.
references: R. Rajpurohit, V. Lalitha, S. G. Srinivasa, Coset Lifted Product Codes, arXiv:2610.12782
provenance.notes: Large-block code of the extended search of arXiv:2610.12782 (m = 240 family). Construction, search procedure and GAP scripts are the paper's; authors Rajendra Rajpurohit, V. Lalitha, Shayan Garani Srinivasa. Distance evidence: QDistRnd 2e5 rounds per side gives 56; this repository's fast RIS at 8M trials (seed 6980315) finds nothing lighter than 48; the orbit-fold search with pynauty automorphisms and the SAT stage finds weight-40 logicals on both sides, carried as witnesses, and nothing lighter at 30000 trials. Classical construction, no AI model. Distinct from the [[960,20]] entry on SmallGroup(480,1005).
